findings.description: The `finally` clause always runs after the except branch, so `job.next_run = now + job.interval` overwrites the `now + self._retry_delay(job)` set at line 65. Failed jobs are therefore never retried sooner, and the retry_delay feature has no effect. Only the success path should schedule at `interval`.
findings.suggestion: Remove the `finally` and set `job.next_run = now + job.interval` in the `else` branch only.
findings.title: finally block overwrites the backoff next_run on failure

findings.description: `job.retry_delay * 2 ** (consecutive_failures - 1)` grows without bound. If `max_failures` is large, or failures keep accumulating, the multiplication eventually raises OverflowError (timedelta overflow) inside the except handler. That exception escapes `_run` and `tick`, so the remaining due jobs are skipped and no record is appended.
findings.suggestion: Cap the exponent, e.g. `2 ** min(job.consecutive_failures - 1, 20)`, or double iteratively and stop once the value reaches `interval`.
findings.title: Unbounded exponent in backoff computation can overflow
